title: Practice 10: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: He translated the Old Testament from Hebrew.
exercises.why: **перевёл** — past tense (masculine) of перевести: perfective (imperfective partner: переводить).

exercises.q: The situation drove Zoe to despair.
exercises.why: **довела** — past tense (feminine) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: Tom seems to have made off with the elk carcass.
exercises.why: **убежал** — past tense (masculine) of убежать: perfective (imperfective partner: убегать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A person named Williams came to see you yesterday.
exercises.why: **приходил** — past tense (masculine) of приходить: imperfective (perfective partner: прийти).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: He carried out his plan.
exercises.why: **привёл** — past tense (masculine) of привести: perfective (imperfective partner: приводить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
exercises.why: **отнёс** — past tense (masculine) of отнести: perfective (imperfective partner: относить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: The priceless china shattered into fragments.
exercises.why: **разлетелся** — past tense (masculine) of разлететься: perfective (imperfective partner: разлетаться).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).

exercises.q: Damiano came to Isabella quickly.
exercises.why: **подошёл** — past tense (masculine) of подойти: perfective (imperfective partner: подходить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: The liner called at Hong Kong.
exercises.why: **зашёл** — past tense (masculine) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Black clouds were passing above the city.
exercises.why: **проплывали** — past tense (plural) of проплывать: imperfective (perfective partner: проплыть).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: We spent the entire day in Yoyogi Park.
exercises.why: **провели** — past tense (plural) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
exercises.ru: Мы весь день ___ в парке Ёёги.

exercises.q: It took many years to build it.
exercises.why: **ушло** — past tense (neuter) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The shoe fell off the horse's hoof.
exercises.why: **отлетела** — past tense (feminine) of отлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: отлетать).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: This is the Volga. We crossed it on a motorboat.
exercises.why: **переплыли** — past tense (plural) of переплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: переплывать).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.ru: Это Волга. Мы её ___ на катере.

exercises.q: What I saw was depressing.
exercises.why: **приводило** — past tense (neuter) of приводить: imperfective (perfective partner: привести).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.ru: То, что я увидел, ___ в уныние.

exercises.q: The officials approached the issue formally.
exercises.why: **подошли** — past tense (plural) of подойти: perfective (imperfective partner: подходить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: Ambition drove him to murder.
exercises.why: **довело** — past tense (neuter) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: The butterfly fluttered from flower to flower.
exercises.why: **перелетала** — past tense (feminine) of перелетать: imperfective (perfective partner: перелететь).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: I didn't bring them here.
exercises.why: **приносил** — past tense (masculine) of приносить: imperfective (perfective partner: принести).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The dog came running to her.
exercises.why: **подбежала** — past tense (feminine) of подбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: подбегать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: **прибежала** — past tense (feminine) of прибежать: perfective (imperfective partner: прибегать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I gave her a ride home.
exercises.why: **подвезла** — past tense (feminine) of подвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: подвозить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: I saw her home.
exercises.why: **проводил** — past tense (masculine) of проводить: imperfective (perfective partner: провести).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: Everybody ran outside.
exercises.why: **выбежали** — past tense (plural) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
